mapper.select: select id, member_no as memberNo, member_name as memberName, status from member order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into member (member_no, member_name, status) values (#{memberNo}, #{memberName}, #{status})

insert into member_process (process_id, process_type, process_name, business_key, trace_id, status, start_time, end_time, elapsed_ms, error_code, error_type, error_message) values (#{processId}, #{processType}, #{processName}, #{businessKey}, #{traceId}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{elapsedMs}, #{errorCode}, #{errorType}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.update: update member_process set status = #{status}, end_time = #{endTime}, elapsed_ms = #{elapsedMs}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_type = #{errorType}, error_message = #{errorMessage} where process_id = #{processId}
mapper.select: select id, process_id as processId, process_type as processType, process_name as processName, business_key as businessKey, trace_id as traceId, status, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, elapsed_ms as elapsedMs, error_code as errorCode, error_type as errorType, error_message as errorMessage from member_process order by id desc

select id, process_id as processId, process_type as processType, process_name as processName, business_key as businessKey, trace_id as traceId, status, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, elapsed_ms as elapsedMs, error_code as errorCode, error_type as errorType, error_message as errorMessage from member_process where process_id = #{processId}
mapper.insert: insert into member_process_step (process_id, step_id, step_name, service_name, status, start_time, end_time, elapsed_ms, error_code, error_type, error_message) values (#{processId}, #{stepId}, #{stepName}, #{serviceName}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{elapsedMs}, #{errorCode}, #{errorType}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: select id, process_id as processId, step_id as stepId, step_name as stepName, service_name as serviceName, status, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, elapsed_ms as elapsedMs, error_code as errorCode, error_type as errorType, error_message as errorMessage from member_process_step where process_id = #{processId} order by id asc
mapper.insert: insert into member_process_event (process_id, step_id, event_type, event_time, service_name, message, status) values (#{processId}, #{stepId}, #{eventType}, #{eventTime}, #{serviceName}, #{message}, #{status})
mapper.select: select id, process_id as processId, step_id as stepId, event_type as eventType, event_time as eventTime, service_name as serviceName, message, status from member_process_event where process_id = #{processId} order by event_time asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into trace_event (trace_id, process_id, business_key, process_type, step_id, service_name, event_type, http_method, path, status, elapsed_ms, error_code, error_message, created_at) values (#{traceId}, #{processId}, #{businessKey}, #{processType}, #{stepId}, #{serviceName}, #{eventType}, #{httpMethod}, #{path}, #{status}, #{elapsedMs}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt})
